name: The State of Lakeshire
summary: In Lakeshire, Magistrate Solomon's report calls for help before the town falls. It urges General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind to send royal army reinforcements against the crisis in Redridge.

sections.title: A Cry for Aid
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon writes of the attacks threatening Lakeshire. Blackrock orcs and gnolls press the town, whose defenders cannot hold the borders indefinitely. Couriers carry his dispatch west along the road to Elwynn Forest. Solomon asks the Stormwind Army to intervene and protect the kingdom's eastern reach.

sections.title: Bureaucracy and Deadlock
sections.body: General Marcus Jonathan receives Solomon's report at Stormwind's gates. He respects the magistrate's standing and understands the danger, but cannot move the army on his own. Deployments need the crown's consent, so Lakeshire's plea must wait for a council with the young King and regent Bolvar Fordragon.

faq.q: What is The State of Lakeshire?
faq.answer: The State of Lakeshire is Magistrate Solomon's official dispatch about the military danger facing Lakeshire, asking Stormwind for troop reinforcements.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive this dispatch?
faq.answer: General Marcus Jonathan is meant to receive the dispatch. He commands the Stormwind city guard and royal forces and is stationed at Stormwind's gates.

faq.q: Why does Lakeshire need royal reinforcements?
faq.answer: Lakeshire needs royal reinforcements because Blackrock orcs, Shadowhide gnolls, and local murlocs keep besieging the settlement, overwhelming its town guard.

faq.q: Does General Marcus Jonathan send help immediately?
faq.answer: No. General Marcus Jonathan agrees the crisis is severe, but he needs the King's formal approval to deploy the army. The request must first go through royal review.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the report shows how exposed the outer settlements are and how political delays in the capital hold up military aid.
As a human of the kingdom, carrying this report shows how the common folk of Redridge are losing their ties to the distant crown in Stormwind.
